run_metadata_code_details_tests: run the gRPC unit tests for application-provided metadata, status code, and details
test_Servicer_unary_unary: test the Servicer unary_unary method to verify client metadata is received and server initial and trailing metadata are sent
test_Servicer_abort_call: test the Servicer abort call behavior across all four RPC types with various abort codes and expected client codes
test_Servicer_custom_code: test the Servicer custom status code and details propagation for unary-unary, unary-stream, stream-unary, and stream-stream RPCs
review_generic_handler: review the generic_handler function that maps unary_unary, unary_stream, stream_unary, and stream_stream methods to gRPC method handlers with serializers
